title: Icesis Couture wins Canada's Drag Race Season 2
summary: In the finale (CA-S02-E10), Icesis Couture, Kendall Gender, and Pythia lip-synced to Céline Dion's "It's All Coming Back to Me Now". Icesis was crowned Canada's Next Drag Superstar; Kendall and Pythia finished as runners-up. The cash prize was $100,000 CAD.

title: Beth: Season 2's Porkchop
summary: Beth was the first contestant eliminated on Canada's Drag Race Season 2 (CA-S02-E01), lip-syncing to Nelly Furtado's "Maneater" against Gia Metric.

title: Season 2 judging panel shake-up
summary: For Canada's Drag Race Season 2, Brad Goreski replaced Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman as a judge, while Amanda Brugel and Traci Melchor replaced Stacey McKenzie. Brooke Lynn Hytes continued as host.

title: Suki Doll voted Miss Congeniality
summary: At the Season 2 reunion (CA-S02-E09), Suki Doll was announced as Miss Congeniality after being voted by her fellow contestants. She had been eliminated in Snatch Game (CA-S02-E04).

title: Top 4 lip-sync smackdown at the reunion
summary: In CA-S02-E09, the top four competed in a lip-sync smackdown to secure the top three. After rounds set to RuPaul's "Main Event" and "Born Naked", Gia Metric and Pythia lip-synced to "Call Me Mother"; Pythia won and Gia was eliminated, leaving Icesis Couture, Kendall Gender, and Pythia in the finale.
